description: Manage per-entity evidence, belief stances, and memory — not objective truth, shared lore, or derived indexes. list, get, evidence, conflicts, perception_list, subjective_list, subjective_verify, and knowledge_query read; admit, retract, reconcile, perception_record, subjective_record, subjective_recall, and subjective_disclose write. admit records a weighted proposition; reconcile recomputes stances; retract needs the admit evidence_id; ledgers are append-only; each memory carries an open/guarded/secret disclosure level gating Player reads; subjective_verify returns each memory with its divergence verdict; correct mistakes with a new record. Mutations persist to the Novel. knowledge_query returns perceptions, beliefs, and secrets. Use when: inspecting what an entity learned or remembers. Do NOT use when: recording objective truth — use manage_causality; recording shared lore — use manage_lore; ranking derived text or traversing the knowledge graph — use manage_knowledge.

action.description: Belief: list, get, evidence, admit, retract, conflicts, or reconcile. Perception ledger: perception_record, perception_list, perception_for_entity, or perception_for_event. Subjective memory: subjective_record, subjective_list, subjective_verify, subjective_disclose, or subjective_recall. Knowledge: knowledge_query.

detail.description: Return full belief records instead of summary entries (list).

entity_id.description: Entity whose beliefs are queried or mutated.

perception_event_ordinal.description: Contributing event-log ordinal (perception_record/perception_for_event; defaults to the latest event).

perception_kind.description: message, scene, or observation (perception_record; default observation).

perception_room_id.description: Room identifier for the perception (perception_record; defaults to the entity's room).

perception_sense.description: Sense that produced the perception (perception_record; default null; REQ-594).

perception_source_entity.description: Entity the perception came from (perception_record; default null).

source.description: Source key used to correlate duplicate evidence (admit; default the active badge).

source_ordinal.description: Contributing event-log ordinal (admit; default the latest event ordinal).

status.description: active, unresolved, or suppressed (admit; default active).

subjective_disclosure.description: Who may see the memory: open (quotable), guarded (gist only), or secret (never quoted) (subjective_record; default secret; subjective_disclose; required).

subjective_entity.description: Entity that remembers, by id or name (subjective_record; filter for subjective_list).

subjective_event_ordinal.description: Contributing event-log ordinal, a non-negative integer (subjective_record; defaults to the latest event).

subjective_felt_then.description: The entity's affect at the event (subjective_record).

subjective_gist.description: What the entity remembers, in its own terms (subjective_record).

subjective_origin.description: How the memory arose (subjective_record; default authored; REQ-623).

subjective_record_id.description: Memory record id to reclassify, e.g. sm-3 (subjective_disclose).

topic.description: Optional topic filter applied to knowledge_query perceptions, beliefs, and secrets.

name: manage_belief

status.description: Machine-readable result status: OK, NEED_INPUT, WARNING, PARTIAL, or ERROR; an error's Appendix O.2 category rides in `category` (REQ-002, REQ-548c).

text.description: Human-readable text envelope mirroring the structured result (REQ-001, REQ-548a).

title: Belief Management (evidence, stances, memory, queries)
